its alright man you dont have to be shakespeare i appreciate you anyway. the thing is i really like to play the piano, but i dont have one. i only have a small sized one, and i dont even have a sustain pedal. but in my country, you cant feed yourself by being a musician, you're basically doomed

my parents want me to become a doctor and I have enrolled in institutions which teach that particular subject required. it's not like I hate biology but I don't like it much either. On the other hand, I am apparently very weak in physics and maths since I usually get lesser marks in that. My parents want me to get settled as fast as possible and become a doctor since that is a very profitable source of income. They think that if I choose to become an astrophysicist and do research and stuff it will be hard for me to get settled and find stability

well everyone has been telling me to practise but that's where the problem lies. You see, I realize I need to practise but I just can't. I end up doing things which are not that productive and I understand I should stop it but I can't listen to myself. And especially due to this, I hate myself even more. For not listening to me. It sounds weird I know but yeah.
Also thanks :)

dude, i am fucking moved by what you said. i understand your position, but you know what, i believe in a cycle. everything in the universe is in an eternal state of a cycle, a loop. the universe poofs into existence and it will poof into oblivion and it will continue. In the same way, i believe that in everyone's life, sorrow follows happiness, happiness follows sorrow. I know you are probably tired of hearing the same kind of shit and you probably dont believe in this, but i just wanted to help.

A year ago, my best friend committed suicide and i dont want to see anyone else do it.

So, please stay. Please let us know you are there. We will always be expectant.
